# Sam's News — email-security — 2026-10-02

## Security

### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 7/10" aria-label="Importance 7 of 10">7</span> Antino backdoor exploits Outlook and OneDrive for command-and-control in China-linked espionage campaign
China-nexus threat actor UAT-11587 deployed the Antino backdoor—a previously undocumented Rust-compiled Windows backdoor—against government and policy organizations across eight Asian countries. Antino uses Microsoft Graph to interact with Outlook and OneDrive as command-and-control channels, enabling host reconnaissance, shell execution, file transfer, and persistence while avoiding traditional C2 infrastructure. Campaign expanded from September 2025 Taiwan targeting to 16 entities across multiple nations by June 2026.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Targets Taiwan, India, Philippines, Cambodia, Pakistan, Thailand, Myanmar, Syria</li>
<li>Uses Outlook and OneDrive as native C2 channels via Microsoft Graph</li>
<li>Previously undocumented Rust-compiled Windows backdoor</li>
<li>Assessed as China-nexus with high confidence based on language, timezone, targeting</li>
<li>Campaign peaked March–June 2026</li>
</ul>
